title: [Chapitre] V. Algèbre des figures : notes manuscrites (14/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. (S,τ) is a topological space and T ⊂ S is a closed subset with open complement U = S∖T. τ'_0 is a topology on T finer than the induced topology τ|T, so the identity (T,τ'_0) → (S,τ) is continuous. The aim is to refine the topology of S only along the closed piece T, leaving the open piece U as it is. In the context of chapter V ('Algèbre des figures', i.e. Alexandrov/'ultra' topologies, preorders and stratified 'figures'), this is a tool for changing the topology on a closed stratum. The next page specialises to Alexandrov ('ultra-topological') spaces and their preorders.

Previous page. The candidate closed sets are the unions A ∪ B, with A τ-closed in S and B ⊂ T τ'_0-closed. These are the closed sets of a topology τ'. On T it induces τ'_0, since (A∪B) ∩ T = (A∩T) ∪ B and A∩T is τ'_0-closed. On U it induces τ|U.

This page, struck-out start. Grothendieck begins the converse by writing a τ'-closed C as C = (C∩T) ∪ cl_{τ'}(C∩U). He abandons this and restates everything as a clean Lemma.

The Lemma. Let 𝔗 be the set of topologies on S that are finer than τ and induce τ'_0 on T.
(a) 𝔗 has a least element τ'.
(b) X ⊂ S is τ'-closed iff:
  1) X_U = X∩U is closed in (U, τ|U);
  2) X_T = X∩T is closed in (T, τ'_0);
  3) cl_τ(X_U) ∩ T ⊂ X_T.

Next page. (c) τ'-closed sets correspond bijectively to pairs (B, A_U) satisfying the compatibility condition in 3). (d) In the Alexandrov case, the preorder of τ' is described piecewise.

Proof check of (b).
- If X = A∪B, then X_U = A∩U is closed in U; X_T = (A∩T) ∪ B is τ'_0-closed; and cl(X_U) ⊂ A, so cl(X_U) ∩ T ⊂ A∩T ⊂ X_T.
- Conversely, suppose 1)–3) hold. By 1), cl_τ(X_U) ∩ U = X_U. By 3), cl_τ(X_U) ∩ T ⊂ X_T. Hence X = cl_τ(X_U) ∪ X_T, which has the form A∪B.

Proof check of minimality in (a). Any σ in 𝔗 contains the τ-closed sets. T is τ-closed, hence σ-closed. Each τ'_0-closed B ⊂ T is closed in (T, σ|T) = (T, τ'_0), hence σ-closed in S. So every A∪B is σ-closed, i.e. τ' ⊂ σ. Here the hypothesis that T is closed is used.

Alternative description. τ' = τ ∨ σ₀, where σ₀ has as closed sets S together with the τ'_0-closed subsets of T. This is the point-set shadow of the open/closed recollement (Artin gluing) of the topoi Sh(U) and Sh(T).
errors: On the previous page, stability under arbitrary intersections is argued via ⋂_{i∈I}(A_i ∪ B_i) = ⋃_{J⊂I}(⋂_J A_i ∩ ⋂_{I∖J} B_j). For infinite I this is a union of infinitely many closed sets, so 'hence closed' does not follow as written. The claim itself is true. Correct argument: ⋂(A_i∪B_i) = (⋂A_i) ∪ [T ∩ ⋂(A_i∪B_i)], and T ∩ (A_i∪B_i) = (A_i∩T) ∪ B_i is τ'_0-closed, so the second term is a τ'_0-closed subset of T. Minor gap only.

The struck-out converse at the top of the page (C = (C∩T) ∪ cl_{τ'}(C∩U)) is abandoned. The clean Lemma (b) replaces it correctly, with closure taken for τ rather than τ'. No error remains in the final statement.

ideas.what: Coarsest topology on S finer than τ inducing a prescribed finer topology τ'_0 on a closed subset T, with closed sets A ∪ B
ideas.modern_name: Refinement of a topology along a closed subspace; join τ ∨ σ₀; point-set gluing of open and closed pieces

ideas.what: Closed sets of S described by pairs (closed set of U, closed set of T) subject to the condition cl(X_U) ∩ T ⊂ X_T
ideas.modern_name: Recollement / Artin gluing of an open and a complementary closed subspace (decategorified)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Artin–Grothendieck–Verdier (SGA4 IV 9.5, recollement of topoi); Beilinson–Bernstein–Deligne for recollement of triangulated categories

deep.surprise_reason: A correct but elementary point-set lemma in service of the 'algèbre des figures' (Alexandrov topologies and preorders). It is the obvious decategorified form of open/closed recollement, nothing new to a specialist.
transcription_corrections: Struck-out top block: the labels 'B' (under the fermé-dans-(T,τ'_0) part) and 'A' (under the closure-in-(S,τ) part) are separate annotations, and the whole block including the N.B. is crossed out.
Condition 3°): the closure bar with superscript (τ) is over X_U, i.e. cl_τ(X_U) ∩ T ⊂ X_T. Earlier crossed-out attempts read 'X∩U' / 'X_T'.
